skills.name: Stored Charge
skills.description: Ando's skills Charge him, granting him Elemental Essence and augmenting his skills for 1 turn. Using a skill while Charged will Supercharge him, granting him Elemental Essence and further augmenting his skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Electroblade
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and marks them with Electroblade. While Charged, this skill also strikes any target affected by Electroblade. While Supercharged, this skill targets all enemies and deals 10 additional damage to targets marked by Electroblade.

skills.name: Flash Step
skills.description: Shatters target enemy until the end of Ando's next turn. While Charged, this skill lasts an additional turn. While Supercharged, this skill affects all targets marked by Electroblade.

skills.name: Expel Energy
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and removes Ando's charge state. If Ando was Charged, this skill deals 10 additional damage. If Ando was Supercharged, it deals 20 additional damage and becomes Piercing. This skill cannot be stunned and does not advance Ando's Charge state.

skills.name: Focus Power
skills.description: Ando advances to the next Charge state. Afterwards, if he is Charged, he strikes all enemies marked by Electroblade for 5 Piercing damage. If he is Supercharged, he marks a random enemy with Electroblade.

skills.name: Overclock
skills.description: For the next 3 turns, after using a Supercharged skill, Ando will become Charged and gain Elemental Essence. This skill can only be used while Supercharged, and extends the duration of his current Supercharge by 1 turn.

skills.name: Modular Core
skills.description: While Charged or Supercharged, Ando ignores non-damage effects.

skills.name: Slicing Spectrum
skills.description: Deals 15 Damage to the enemy team, along with an additional random effect from among: Deals 10 additional Affliction damage to all targets, Lowers all targets' damage by 5 for their next turn, Grants all allies 10 Shield, or Increases Ando's damage by 10 for his next turn.

skills.name: Capacitor Upgrade
skills.description: Expel Energy deals 5 more damage each time Ando gains Charged or Supercharged. This effect stacks and is removed when Expel Energy is used.

skills.name: Rev
skills.description: Deals 15 Damage to target enemy and generating another stack of Capacitor Upgrade. Every use of this skill wil generate an additional stack, up to 3.

skills.name: Conductive Combo
skills.description: Electroblade's Mark effect now lasts for Ando's next three turns.

skills.name: Rising Geyser
skills.description: Deals 20 Damage to target enemy and marks them with Rising Geyser for 3 turns. Targets marked by Rising Geyser replicate all new damage they receive to other marked targets.

skills.name: Ionic Cloaking
skills.description: Ando is Stealthed while Supercharged. (He will not trigger enemy effects.)

skills.name: Singularity
skills.description: For the next 2 turns, Ando will cast Electroblade on any enemy who attempts to become Invulnerable, and will cast Flash Step on any enemy who uses a harmful skill.

skills.name: Charge Absorption
skills.description: Whenever Ando's skills gain additional targets, he gains 10 Shield for each extra target affected.

skills.name: Opposites Attract
skills.description: For 1 turn, any helpful skill used on target enemy will be reflected to Ando, and any damaging skills used on Ando will be reflected to target enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Laser Edge
skills.description: Enemies marked by Electroblade receive 5 Affliction Damage each turn.

skills.name: Burning Crescent
skills.description: Deals 35 Damage to target enemy. This skill Bypasses on targets marked by Electroblade, and deals 10 additional damage to Shattered enemies.

skills.name: Lightning Revenant
skills.description: Ando is permanently Isolated. If Ando gains Charged, he heals for 5 Health. If he gains Supercharged, he heals for 10 Health.

skills.name: Mannequin Protocol
skills.description: Deals 25 Damage to target enemy. This skill cannot be stunned. If used while Stunned, this skill Bypasses and cannot be Countered or Reflected.

skills.name: Erratic Programming
skills.description: Ando is permanently Blinded, but he deals 10 Piercing damage to an additional random target whenevery he uses a Harmful skill.

skills.name: Tempest
skills.description: Ando deals 15 damage to a random enemy. For the next 3 turns, he will repeat this damage on another random target.

skills.name: God of Thunder
skills.description: Ando permanently deals 5 additional damage with all of his abilities whenever he uses a Supercharged skill.

skills.name: Split the Heavens
skills.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to all enemies. This skill receives double benefit from God of Thunder.

skills.name: Silent Avenger
skills.description: Ando will immediately become Supercharged if an allied hero is killed. This Supercharge lasts for his next two turns and is not consumed by his abilities.

skills.name: Penance
skills.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. If used during Silent Avenger, this skill first removes all Shield from the target and its damage becomes Piercing.

skills.name: Stored Charge
skills.description: Ando's skills Charge him, granting him Elemental Essence and augmenting his skills for 1 turn. Using a skill while Charged will Supercharge him, granting him Elemental Essence and further augmenting his skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Stored Charge
skills.description: Ando's skills Charge him, granting him Elemental Essence and augmenting his skills for 1 turn. Using a skill while Charged will Supercharge him, granting him Elemental Essence and further augmenting his skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dune Stalker
skills.description: Aramao deals 5 more damage to the enemy Hero directly across from him, and he gains Elemental Essence whenever he damages them.

skills.name: Desert Knife
skills.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If used on an enemy Hero that isn't directly across from Aramao, he will swap positions with the ally that is. Using this skill does not break Veiled.

skills.name: Sand Quake
skills.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to all enemies and extends the duration of all Veiled effects by 2 turns. Using this skill does not break Veiled.

skills.name: Mirage Trap
skills.description: Aramao targets an enemy Hero for 1 turn. If they are directly across from Aramao, he will counter the first non-Strategic skill they use. If they are not, he will counter the first Strategic skill they use.

skills.name: Desert Veil
skills.description: Targets an allied Hero or Aramao. If targeting Aramao, applies Veiled to Aramao and a random allied Hero for 2 turns. If targeting an ally, applies Veiled to them and Aramao for 2 turns and swaps their positions.

skills.name: Heart of the Desert
skills.description: If there is only one Hero adjacent to Aramao, heal that Hero and Aramao for 15 HP. If there are two Heroes adjacent to Aramao, heal them both for 15 HP. This effect Bypasses.

skills.name: Trial of the Sands
skills.description: For 3 turns, all allied Heroes are Veiled at the end of each turn. During this time, Aramao will use Desert Knife on any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him. After being used, Aramao's team randomly swaps places once.

skills.name: Revered Daughter
skills.description: Ayana gains 5 points of permanent damage reduction for each of her living allies

skills.name: Voice of Light
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. If that enemy deals new damage this turn, Ayana gains Elemental Essence

skills.name: Chorus
skills.description: For Ayana's next 2 turns, Voice of Light and Prayer will affect all valid targets.

skills.name: Prayer
skills.description: Ayana heals target ally for 10 HP. If they receive new damage next turn, Ayana gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Cloister
skills.description: The Damage Reduction from Revered Daughter is doubled for 1 turn.

skills.name: Voice of Glory
skills.description: Voice of Light and Prayer permanently last 1 additional turn. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Choir On High
skills.description: Whenever Ayana uses Chorus, she summons two Angel minions. While either of them is alive, Chorus is permanent. When both Angels are killed, Chorus immediately ends.

skills.name: Providence
skills.description: Heals Ayana or an ally for 35 HP.

skills.name: Maiden of Purity
skills.description: Using Chorus or Voice of Glory will heal your most damaged ally for 15 HP.

skills.name: Blessed Leylines
skills.description: Target ally becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and permanently receives 5 more healing from all sources (this effect does not stack).

skills.name: Panacea
skills.description: Every 3 turns, Ayana is cleansed of all enemy effects at the end of her turn.

skills.name: Healing Hands
skills.description: Target ally is healed 30 HP. If this skill is used on Ayana, it activates Panacea.

skills.name: Godly Wisdom
skills.description: Every 3 times enemies trigger Voice of Light or Prayer, Ayana automatically uses Voice of Glory.

skills.name: Verse of Ascension
skills.description: Ayana ignores harmful effects for 2 turns and activates Chorus. This skill cannot be stunned.

skills.name: Searing Rebuke
skills.description: If an enemy triggers Voice of Light, they receive 15 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Final Word
skills.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to target enemy. If Ayana and her target have no living allies, Final Word deals double damage.

skills.name: Illumination
skills.description: While Prism Sentence is active, all invisible skills become visible.

skills.name: Prism Sentence
skills.description: Stuns target enemy for 2 turns. During this time, they will receive double damage from Voice of Light and casting Voice of Light on them will also cast it on the enemy team, Bypassing.

skills.name: Hallowed Footsteps
skills.description: When dealing damage to or healing a target affected by your Consecrate, deal 10 additional damage or healing to them. This effect is not triggered by Consecrate.

skills.name: Consecrate
skills.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to all enemies for 5 turns, and heals all allies for 5 HP for 5 turns.

skills.name: Divine Ire
skills.description: Whenever an enemy deals damage to Ayana's allies, she permanently deals 5 additional damage to them with Voice of Light (stacks).

skills.name: Voice of Vengeance
skills.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each dead ally. If both allies are dead, this damage becomes Piercing.

skills.name: Word of the Law
skills.description: Triggering Voice of Light causes the target to take 10 additional damage from it for 2 turns.

skills.name: Bounty
skills.description: Target enemy is Shattered for 2 turns. Allies who deal damage to them are healed for 10 health during this time.

skills.name: Inquisition
skills.description: Triggering Voice of Light now Isolates the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Purge the Wicked
skills.description: For 3 turns, all units are Shattered, but become immune to counters and stuns.

skills.name: Exile
skills.description: When the Black Knight acts alone, his abilities are enhanced and he gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Oathbreaker Strike
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to 1 enemy. While enhanced, deals 10 more damage and becomes piercing.

skills.name: Misery
skills.description: For 2 turns, the Black Knight deals 5 additional damage for each 30 health his team is missing, up to 20. While enhanced, this skill lasts an additional turn.

skills.name: Unholy Aura
skills.description: For 2 turns, all allies and enemies deal 5 less damage. While enhanced, this skill only targets enemies and affected enemies deal 10 less damage.

skills.name: Dead or Alive
skills.description: The Black Knight ignores all new Harmful skills for 1 turn. While enhanced, this skill also redirects harmful skills from his allies to himself. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: The Nightmare Rides
skills.description: For 2 turns, the Black Knight is invulnerable. During this time, Oathbreaker Strike will target all enemies and is always enhanced.

skills.name: Plaguebringer
skills.description: Enemies affected by the Black Knight's enhanced abilities take 5 Affliction damage each turn, permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Fester
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to a target affected by Plaguebringer, and lowers their damage by 5, permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Lonely Thirst
skills.description: The Black Knight heals 5 health whenever he damages an enemy, increased to 10 if his skills are enhanced.

skills.name: Bloodsoaked Strike
skills.description: Deals 40 damage to target enemy. While enhanced, this skill deals 15 less damage, but its damage changes to Affliction and it becomes AOE.

skills.name: The Onyx Legion
skills.description: Allies affected by Curse of Fealty never count as acting when determining if The Black Knight is acting alone.

skills.name: Curse of Fealty
skills.description: The Black Knight targets an enemy or one of his allies. For 3 turns, that unit deals 5 less non-Affliction damage and the Black Knight deals 5 more damage. If empowered, this skill affects another random valid target.

skills.name: Hellfire
skills.description: The Black Knight's abilities permanently apply Hellfire to all enemy targets affected, dealing 5 affliction damage every turn. This effect does not stack

skills.name: Infernal Blow
skills.description: The Black Knight draws in the Hellfire from all targets, dealing 10 affliction damage to any target that had a stack. Then he deals 15 damage to one target, increased by 5 for every stack removed

skills.name: Merciless
skills.description: Oathbreaker Strike may now be used on allied Heroes. If the Black Knight kills an ally in this way, he deals 10 additional damage for the rest of the game.

skills.name: Horrify
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to a target and stuns them for 1 turn. While enhanced, the target is also Isolated for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ethereal Form
skills.description: The turn after ignoring a skill, the Black Knight deals 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Ghostblade
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If under the effect of Ethereal Form, this damage bypasses and becomes piercing.

skills.name: Gravekeeper
skills.description: The Black Knight begins play with 3 Grave minions.

skills.name: Bury
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each living Zombie. If this kills an enemy, the Black Knight creates a Grave if he has space.

skills.name: Legion of the Damned
skills.description: When the Black Knight uses an enhanced ability, he summons two Skeleton minions. Maximum 4.

skills.name: Boneshape
skills.description: Sacrifices a Skeleton minion and gives the Black Knight 20 Shield.

skills.name: Unflinching Thrall
skills.description: While the Black Knight has a Reanimated ally, he gains 15 DR

skills.name: Reanimate
skills.description: Reanimates one dead ally, reviving them with 50 HP, and permanently stunning their Strategic skills.

skills.name: Hunger for Battle
skills.description: The Black Knight deals 5 additional damage whenever he deals damage. This effect stacks, but is removed if the Black Knight ends a turn without dealing damage.

skills.name: Fervor
skills.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to a target, and gives the Black Knight Elemental Essence

skills.name: Arise!
skills.description: Sacrifices this minion to create a Zombie Minion (40 HP, r: Deals 10 damage to 1 enemy.)

skills.name: Bonechill
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Shambling Smash
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. Using this skill does not deactivate Exile.

skills.name: Fear Manifest
skills.description: Darkness-Outside-The-Door cannot be damaged by other units. Instead, whenever he receives a new Harmful Skill with no stacks of Pure Horror, he receives 25 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Rip and Tear
skills.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each stack of Pure Horror on them. Applies one stack of Pure Horror.

skills.name: Psychotic Break
skills.description: Target enemy is stunned for 1 turn. Can only be used on a target with at least 2 stacks of Pure Horror.

skills.name: Drag Into Darkness
skills.description: Targets one enemy. If they have less than 10 HP per stack of Pure Horror on them, they are executed. If not, they gain 2 stacks of Pure Horror.

skills.name: Pure Horror
skills.description: All enemies receive 2 stacks of Pure Horror. One stack is removed each time they use a new Skill. Whenever Pure Horror is applied to an enemy without it, Darkness-Outside-The-Door gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Devour Fear
skills.description: All stacks of Pure Horror are removed from all enemies. For each stack removed, Darkness-Outside-The-Door is healed for 10 HP.

skills.name: Final Night
skills.description: For the next 4 turns, all enemies receive 1 stack of Pure Horror each turn. During this time, enemies receive 5 Affliction damage for each stack of Pure Horror on them each turn.

skills.name: Pain Tolerance
skills.description: If Hector the Injector is on this Hero's team, Hector's passive won't create a minion at the start of the round, and all of Hector's skills that refer to Dennis will refer to this Hero instead. If Dennis is damaged, he will gain Elemental Essence and 5 Damage Reduction until the end of his next turn. This effect stacks, but does not refresh. Dennis can only gain Elemental Essence from this effect once per turn.

skills.name: Big Green Fist
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each stack of Pain Tolerance currently on Dennis.

skills.name: HS-112 Fury Serum
skills.description: For 4 turns any unit Dennis damages and any unit that damages him is Taunted for 1 turn. This effect can not stack on enemies or Dennis.

skills.name: HS-46 Ascendant Serum
skills.description: Dennis takes 5 Affliction damage, ignores non-damage effects for 1 turn, and Big Green Fist deals 10 more damage until the end of his next turn.

skills.name: Shared Agony
skills.description: Dennis deals 5 damage to all enemy units, and all enemy units deal 5 Piercing damage to him.

skills.name: HS-88 Reconstitution Serum
skills.description: Dennis heals 5 HP each turn (stacks).

skills.name: End of Shift
skills.description: Dennis takes 25 Affliction damage, then uses HS-112 Fury Serum, HS-46 Ascendant Serum, and HS-88 Reconstitution Serum on himself.

skills.name: Dwindling Flame
skills.description: Fate can only be healed by his own skills and effects. While his HP is at or above 50, allies affected by Fox Fire deal 5 more non-Affliction damage. While his HP is below 50, enemies affected by Fox Fire deal 5 less non-Affliction damage.

skills.name: Fox Fire
skills.description: Target enemy or ally is marked by Fox Fire for 4 turns. During this time, if they use or receive a new Harmful skill, they will take 5 Affliction damage if they are an enemy or heal 5 HP if they are an ally. When affected units use new skills on Fate, he gains Elemental Essence. Refreshes if applied on an already affected target.

skills.name: Will-o'-wisp
skills.description: Fate deals 5 Affliction damage to himself, then gives his team 10 Shield for 2 turns. During this time, any enemy that uses a new Harmful skill on Fate or his allies will receive 10 Affliction damage (this damage can only trigger once per skill).

skills.name: Vulpus Incendia
skills.description: Fate deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy each turn. As long as this skill remains active, Fox Fire deals double damage when triggered. Channeled.

skills.name: Vulpus Crystallia
skills.description: Fate heals an ally 10 HP each turn. As long as this skill remains active, Fox Fire gives double healing when triggered. Channeled.

skills.name: Fox's Cunning
skills.description: For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill will be affected by Fox Fire. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: This Is Not The End
skills.description: For the next 2 turns, the first time Fate or an ally would die, they are returned to 40 HP instead. Afterward, the revived Hero heals 5 HP for every active Fox Fire. This skill can only be triggered once per round.

skills.name: Yggdrasil's Bounty
skills.description: At the start of the game, Gaia creates two Seedling minions.

skills.name: Sprout Seedling
skills.description: Creates a Seedling minion. Maximum 3.

skills.name: Worldfist
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for each time Channel Earth has been used this battle.

skills.name: Channel Vitality
skills.description: Gaia heals target ally for 10 HP. For the rest of the turn, if any of Gaia's minions act, that ally will be healed for 10 HP.

skills.name: Rampart
skills.description: Gaia gains 20 permanent Shield, increased by 5 for each time Channel Earth has been used this battle.

skills.name: Worldmarch
skills.description: All active Seedling minions become Worldsprout minions permanently.

skills.name: Rotten Vitality
skills.description: Seedling Minions return to the battlefield 1 turn after they die.

skills.name: Decompose
skills.description: Target enemy loses 20 health. This health loss is not considered damage of any kind.

skills.name: Roiling Life
skills.description: Enemies damaged by Worldfist take 10 damage on the following turn. This effect lasts one additional turn with each time Channel Earth has been used.

skills.name: Overgrowth
skills.description: Deals 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. This effect Bypasses if the target is affected by Roiling Life

skills.name: Magnetic Shielding
skills.description: When Rampart's Shield takes damage, Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth.

skills.name: Ancient Railgun
skills.description: Removes all Shield from Gaia and then deals Piercing damage to target enemy equal to the Shield removed. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Rising Indignation
skills.description: Whenever Gaia receives new damage, the cost of Gaia's Fury is reduced by [65], stacking. At 3 stacks, Gaia's Fury is automatically cast. During this time, Moonspike may not be used, and the Gaia's Fury minion deals and receives 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Gaia's Fury
skills.description: For 3 turns, Gaia is stunned and ignores damage. She creates a Gaia, Enraged minion with HP equal to her current HP.

skills.name: Branch of the World Tree
skills.description: Channel Vitality now costs [65] and affects all targets, but can only target minions.

skills.name: Yggdrasil
skills.description: Summons a World Tree minion. This skill costs [39] less for each Seedling minion Gaia controls.

skills.name: Oasis
skills.description: At the end of each turn, if Gaia or her allied Heroes did not have Elemental Essence, they gain Elemental Essence and heal 10 HP.

skills.name: Sandstorm
skills.description: Deals 5 damage to the enemy team for 4 turns. During this time, Rampart costs [65], and enemies damaged by Worldfist are Blinded for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sacred Grove
skills.description: Until they use a Harmful skill, the allied Heroes heal for 5 health per turn. If an ally under this effect is damaged, the attacker is marked by Sacred Grove.

skills.name: Expel Intruders
skills.description: Target enemy marked by Sacred Grove takes 15 damage and is stunned for 1 turn. This consumes the mark and will not remove Sacred Grove from Gaia.

skills.name: Nutrient Sludge
skills.description: Whenever Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth, she heals all allied minions 5 HP. If they are at max HP, they gain 5 max HP.

skills.name: Life From the Loam
skills.description: Heals all allied units for 25 HP. Whenever an allied unit dies, this skill costs 1 less [22] for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shroomtender
skills.description: Instead of Seedling minions, Gaia now begins play with one Mushroom minion.

skills.name: Sow the Spores
skills.description: Deals 10 affliction damage to the enemy team, increased by 10 for each Mushroom Minion in the game.

skills.name: Nurturing Light
skills.description: At the end of her turn, all active Seedling minions gain 10 max HP.

skills.name: Sunbeam
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each 20 HP among Seedling minions Gaia controls. After using this skill, all Seedling minions have their max HP returned to their default.

skills.name: Killing Frenzy
skills.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Moon Spike
skills.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 5 per 10 HP Gaia is missing.

skills.name: Poison Puff
skills.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Fruit of the World Tree
skills.description: Heals target ally for 20 health.

skills.name: Ancient Roots
skills.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Channel Earth
skills.description: Gaia gains Elemental Essence and 1 permanent stack of Channel Earth.

skills.name: Treant Smash
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Vitality Transfer
skills.description: Heals target ally for the Worldsprout's current HP. After using this skill, the Worldsprout will die.

skills.name: The Storm Builds
skills.description: Galazax's damaging skills apply a stack of The Storm Builds. Galazax gains Elemental Essence if he uses a skill while Channeling.

skills.name: The Sky Darkens
skills.description: Galazax deals 5 Piercing damage to all enemies each turn. Cannot be used while active.

skills.name: Lightning Strikes
skills.description: Galazax deals 10 damage to target enemy and 5 damage to a random enemy.

skills.name: Pressure Rises
skills.description: Galazax moves all stacks of The Storm Builds from target enemy to himself. If 2 or more stacks are removed, this deals 5 Piercing damage to the target. If 4 or more stacks are removed, stun the target for 1 turn. Using this skill does not interrupt Channeling.

skills.name: The Heavens Speak
skills.description: Consumes all stacks of The Storm Builds on Galazax, dealing 10 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each stack and applying that many stacks of The Storm Builds to the target.

skills.name: Thunder Deafens
skills.description: Galazax becomes untargetable and ignores all damage for 1 turn. Using this skill does not interrupt Channeling.

skills.name: The Vortex Consumes
skills.description: Galazax deals 15 Piercing damage to all enemies each turn for 3 turns. This skill applies an extra stack of The Storm Builds to all targets. To use this skill, Galazax must consume 10 stacks of The Storm Builds from himself and must be Channeling The Sky Darkens.

skills.name: Frost-Covered
skills.description: At the start of each round, Gommar gains Frost-Covered, enhancing his skills. If Gommar damages an enemy with reduced damage, he gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Iceblood Hammer
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy and lower their damage by 5 for 3 turns. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, he then deals 10 damage to the enemy team.

skills.name: Foot of the Mountain
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to the enemy team. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, enemies have their strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Breath of the North
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy and lowers their damage by 5 until the end of Gommar's next turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, this skill cannot be countered and deals Piercing damage.

skills.name: Ice Body
skills.description: Makes Gommar invulnerable to non-strategic skills for 1 turn and regains Frost-Covered. If he was already Frost-Covered, he gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Absolute Zero
skills.description: All enemies and allies have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn. If Gommar is not Frost-Covered, he is also stunned.

skills.name: Forced Adaptation
skills.description: While Gommar is Frost-Covered, he ignores non-damage effects.

skills.name: Cold Snap
skills.description: Stuns target enemy's Strategic Skills for 1 turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, the target also receives 15 damage.

skills.name: Dazzling Lights
skills.description: The first enemy to use a skill on Gommar while he is Frost-Covered will have their skill costs increased by [65] for 1 turn.

skills.name: Aurora Veil
skills.description: Gommar's team becomes invulnerable to Strategic skills for 1 turn. The following turn, they are invulnerable to non-Strategic skills.

skills.name: Frosted Facets
skills.description: Gommar takes half damage from new Harmful skills.

skills.name: Crystalline Smash
skills.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy and 10 damage to both the target's allies. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, all damaged enemies have their Strategic Skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Glacial Advance
skills.description: At the start of each round, Gommar gains 5 Damage Reduction and is stunned for 2 turns. When this effect expires, he permanently ignores stun effects.

skills.name: Glacier Crash
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Icy Blood
skills.description: Gommar ignores periodic Affliction damage.

skills.name: Frozen Heart
skills.description: For his next 2 turns, Gommar is permanently Frost-Covered and ignores harmful non-damage effects. When this skill ends, Gommar dies.

skills.name: Two Crowns
skills.description: At the start of each round, Gommar summons Bjorn, True King.

skills.name: King's Saddle
skills.description: For the next 3 turns, Bjorn, True King is stunned and redirects any damage Gommar would take to himself. If Gommar consumes Frost-Covered, Bjorn, True King will cast Sovereign's Howl on a random enemy. Cannot be used if Bjorn, True King has been killed.

skills.name: Black Ice
skills.description: While Gommar is Frost-Covered, he is Stealthed.

skills.name: Midnight Mountain
skills.description: Deals 45 damage to target enemy. If Gommar is Stealthed, this skill Bypasses. If used while Frost-Covered, lowers the target's damage by 10 for 3 turns.

skills.name: Snowy Glare
skills.description: Whenever Gommar gains Frost-Covered, enemies with lowered damage are Blinded for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dancing Lights
skills.description: Gommar gives his team 10 Damage Reduction for 2 turns, healing them for 5 HP per turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, he deals 10 piercing damage to the enemy team for 2 turns.

skills.name: Natural Cryogenics
skills.description: While Frost-Covered, Gommar heals for 15 health per turn if he takes no action.

skills.name: Keeper of Beasts
skills.description: Creates a Frozen Beast minion. This minion is permanently stunned until Gommar loses Frost-Covered.

skills.name: Hypothermia
skills.description: When Gommar deals new damage to an enemy, he increases the damage they receive from all sources by 5 for 2 turns. This effect does not stack.

skills.name: Howling Gale
skills.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. If the target was already affected by Hypothermia, they are stunned for 1 turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, they are stunned for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Sovereign's Howl
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy for 2 turns, and lowers the damage they deal by 5 permanently.

skills.name: Might of the Bjorn
skills.description: Target ally gains 5 increased damage and 10 Damage Reduction for 2 turns.

skills.name: Frozen Fangs
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy

skills.name: Dennis the Apprentice
skills.description: At the start of each round, Hector summons Dennis the Apprentice. Whenever Hector uses a Serum skill on Dennis, he gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Burning Blood Serum
skills.description: Injects Dennis with Burning Blood Serum, increasing his damage dealt by 10 for 3 turns. This effect stacks, but Dennis takes 10 damage per turn per stack.

skills.name: Stoneseal Serum
skills.description: Injects Dennis with Stoneseal Serum, healing him for 10 health per turn for 3 turns, but increasing his skill costs by 1 Generic energy.

skills.name: Mindfog Serum
skills.description: Injects Dennis with Mindfog Serum, increasing his cooldowns by 1 and making him ignore stuns and counters for 3 turns. During this time, Lumbering Smash will stun its targets non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Protect Me!
skills.description: Reflects all harmful skills used on Hector to Dennis for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Serum Overload
skills.description: Refreshes the duration of all Serums affecting Dennis to 3 turns, and removes their negative effects. If Dennis is dead and he was a minion when he died, he returns to life with 50HP.

skills.name: Cure-All
skills.description: Hector's Serums may now target any of his allies, and they remove one harmful effect on application and expiration.

skills.name: Inoculation
skills.description: Target ally is cleansed of all enemy effects, and cannot be affected by those effects for the rest of the game.

skills.name: Got a Job To Do
skills.description: Hector's Serums can now only be used on enemies. Being affected by a Serum also causes the target to receive 5 affliction damage for 3 turns.

skills.name: To Your Health!
skills.description: For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a skill they will receive 15 Affliction damage and be stunned for 1 turn. If this skill ends without being triggered, Hector and the enemy team heal 15 HP. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Borrowed Time
skills.description: Applies a random Serum to Dennis that he isn't already affected by whenever Hector gains energy from Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Serum Synthesizer
skills.description: Creates a Synthesizer minion.

skills.name: Apprenticeborn Pathogen
skills.description: Enemies damaged by Dennis receive Apprenticeborn Pathogen. This deals 5 damage the turn it is applied, lowers the target's damage by 10 for 1 turn the following turn, and then stuns the target on the final turn. Cannot be applied to enemies affected by Mutated Strain or Apprenticeborn Pathogen.

skills.name: Mutated Strain
skills.description: Places a mutated version of Apprenticeborn Pathogen onto target enemy whose effects work in reverse order. The damage reduction effect is twice as strong, and the damage effect is five times as strong. Cannot be applied to enemies affected by Mutated Strain or Apprenticeborn Pathogen.

skills.name: Dennisyphus
skills.description: All of Hector's [14] costs change to [65], but he no longer generates an Energy each turn. Dennis the Apprentice will use Lumbering Smash on a random enemy every turn.

skills.name: Pulverizing Smash
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. At the beginning of Hector's next turn, he gains 1 Generic Energy.

skills.name: Perfect Form
skills.description: Hector consumes Dennis at the beginning of the round, gaining 50 Shield and 3 Elemental Essence. Hectors Serums now only target himself, and last 2 turns instead of 3.

skills.name: Morphic Strike
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If Hector is affected by Burning Blood Serum, this skill deals 5 additional damage and becomes Piercing. If he is affected by Stoneseal Serum, he heals for 10 health. If he is affected by Mindfog Serum, he becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: A Dash of Whimsy
skills.description: Hector will use a random serum on the first character to use a skill on him each turn

skills.name: A Sprinkle of Recklessness
skills.description: If used on an ally, lowers the cost of their helpful skills by [65] for 1 turn and if they use a new skill, they will gain Elemental Essence. If used on an enemy, increases the cost of their Harmful skills by [65] for 1 turn and if they do not use a new skill during this time they will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Try the Supply
skills.description: Applies any Serums Hector uses to himself as well.

skills.name: Avatar Serum
skills.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies for each serum on Hector each turn for 3 turns. During this time he ignores non-damage effects.

skills.name: Lingering Spores
skills.description: Whenever a Serum effect ends, a stack of Lingering Spores is placed on Dennis and a random enemy, dealing 5 affliction damage per turn if they are an enemy, and 5 healing per turn if they are an ally. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Acceleration Serum
skills.description: After 3 turns, the target receives 40 affliction damage. On application, this effect lowers its duration by 1 turn for each stack of Lingering Spores on the target.

skills.name: Rejuvenation Serum
skills.description: Any time an allied Hero becomes invulnerable, they heal 5 health for 3 turns.

skills.name: Rejuvenation Pod
skills.description: Gives an ally under the effect of Rejuvenation Serum 30 Shield, and the duration of Rejuvenation Serum is refreshed to maximum.

skills.name: Synthesize Serum
skills.description: The Synthesizer stores a permanent copy of all Serums on the target that it does not currently hold.

skills.name: Catalyze Serum
skills.description: The Synthesizer applies all of its stored serums to target unit.

skills.name: Lumbering Smash
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Cinders
skills.description: When Jarrik damages an enemy marked by this skill, he deals 10 additional Affliction damage and gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Blade of Ashes
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and permanently marks them with Cinders.

skills.name: Cinderswell
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies. If any target is marked by Cinders, all enemies are Shattered for 2 turns.

skills.name: Call Cinders
skills.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies marked by Cinders. Those marks are then removed, creating a Cinderling minion for each mark removed.

skills.name: Wall of Sparks
skills.description: Grants Jarrik 15 Shield for 1 turn for each active Cinders mark or Cinderling minion.

skills.name: Blade of Dancing Lights
skills.description: Withdraws all active Cinders marks and consumes any active Cinderling minions. For a number of turns equal to the total consumed, Blade of Ashes targets all enemies and Jarrik will automatically create a Cinderling minion whenever he triggers his Cinders.

skills.name: Drunken Swordsman
skills.description: Jarrik will deal 10 piercing damage to any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him. At the end of each turn, Jarrik will deal 10 piercing damage to a random enemy.

skills.name: Cindersprig Brew
skills.description: Jarrik or target ally deal 5 more non-Affliction damage for the next 4 turns. This effect will end if they use a new skill.

skills.name: Final Breath
skills.description: The first time Jarrik dies, he instead becomes Immortal for one turn.

skills.name: Last Light
skills.description: Jarrik deals damage equal to his missing HP to target enemy.

skills.name: Scorched Flesh
skills.description: Enemies affected by Cinders have the cost of their Strategic skills increased by [65].

skills.name: Brimsteel Scabbard
skills.description: Jarrik's next Blade of Ashes deals triple damage, cannot be countered, and if it strikes an enemy affected by Cinders, it automatically creates a Cinderling minion

skills.name: Belphegor's Blade
skills.description: Each turn that Jarrik or an enemy affected by Cinders doesn't use a new skill, they receive 15 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Chains of Sloth
skills.description: For the next 3 turns, target enemy's skills cost 1 more [65], increasing by 1 each turn. Each time they use a new skill, this effect's current magnitude decreases by 1.

skills.name: Drake Transformation
skills.description: At the end of each turn and whenever he consumes a mark from Cinders, Jarrik heals 5 HP and permanently deals 5 more Affliction damage.

skills.name: Drakken
skills.description: Deals 40 Affliction damage to target enemy. After using this skill, Jarrik can no longer apply, trigger, or consume Cinders.

skills.name: Pursuit of Justice
skills.description: Jarrik can no longer be stunned or countered.

skills.name: Execution Sentence
skills.description: Target enemy gains 5 stacks of Execution Sentence. Each time they use a skill, one stack will be removed. When they have no more stacks, they are instantly killed.

skills.name: Blazer Board
skills.description: Whenever Jarrik consumes a mark from Cinders, he becomes Invulnerable until the end of his next turn. This effect is automatically activated at the start of each round.

skills.name: Pop Off
skills.description: Jarrik deals 10 Affliction damage to target enemy. If they were marked by Cinders, he consumes the mark. If they weren't, he applies Cinders to them. This skill is only usable the turn after activating Blazer Board.

skills.name: Blue Flame Spirits
skills.description: Cinderling minions are replaced by Azure Sparkling minions.

skills.name: Awakener's Spark
skills.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage and applies Cinders to up to 3 different, random enemies.

skills.name: Ritual of the Reaper
skills.description: When Jarrik takes or deals damage, he gains that much Ritual Power, up to a maximum of 120.

skills.name: Scythe of Cinders
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and marks them with Cinders. Can only be used if Ritual of the Reaper has at least 60 Ritual Power. If Ritual of the Reaper has 120 Ritual Power, this skill will strike its target twice.

skills.name: Dusken Ascendant
skills.description: Jarrik is permanently Blinded and creates one Cinder minion at the end of each turn.

skills.name: Dawnbreak
skills.description: For the next 3 turns, all enemies are treated as though they are affected by Cinders. This effect cannot be consumed to create Cinderling minions.

skills.name: Cinder Splash
skills.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to the enemy team, killing the Cinder minion.

skills.name: Cinder Splash
skills.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to the enemy team.

skills.name: Awakened Spark
skills.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to all enemies, Bypassing.

skills.name: Tales to Tell
skills.description: Keeper of Fables gains Elemental Essence whenever one of his allies does. Whenever this occurs, he gains 10 Shield.

skills.name: Page-turner
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 25 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, he deals 25 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Character Development
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 25 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, he heals target ally for 30 HP.

skills.name: Chronicle Deeds
skills.description: If target enemy uses a new skill this turn, Tales to Tell will gain 35 Shield. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: Plot Armor
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 20 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, he makes target ally invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hero's Return
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 75 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, target dead ally returns to life at 50 HP.

skills.name: All Is Lost
skills.description: Whenever an allied hero dies, Keeper of Fables increases the Shield on Tales to Tell by 35.

skills.name: Tale of a Ruined World
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 40 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, he deals 25 Affliction damage to the enemy team and lowers their damage by 5 for 2 turns.

skills.name: Stellar Story
skills.description: Whenever Keeper successfully consumes Shield from Tales to Tell, he gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Colorful Characters
skills.description: Keeper of Fables adds 20 Shield to Tales to Tell. This Shield increases to 30 if another ally acts this turn, and increased again to 45 if both allies act this turn.

skills.name: Chronicle Fragments
skills.description: Whenever the Shield from Tales to Tell is broken by damage, Keeper of Tales receives a stack of Chronicle Fragments. These Fragments are consumed by his abilities, counting as 10 Shield each.

skills.name: The World Mirror
skills.description: Keeper of Fables adds 60 Shield to Tales to Tell. This skill costs 1 less [65] for each stack of Chronicle Fragments on Keeper of Tales, with all stacks being consumed on use.

skills.name: Glacial Pacing
skills.description: Keeper of Tales begins the game with his skill costs increased by [65] [65]. Each turn for 2 turns, his skills will cost one less [65] permanently and Tales to Tell will gain 25 Shield.

skills.name: Iced Shelf
skills.description: Keeper of Fables and target enemy become permanently stunned until a Helpful or Harmful skill is used on one of them. When this effect is ended this way for one target, it ends for all targets.

skills.name: Licherature
skills.description: Keeper of Fables may no longer receive healing from any source. Tales to Tell now grants 10 additional Shield whenever it activates.

skills.name: Tale from Beyond
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 25 Shield from Tales to Tell. If successful, he deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each dead ally.

skills.name: Wise Old Man
skills.description: The Shield from Tales to Tell no longer prevents damage to Keeper of Fables. When Keeper of Fables dies, his allies gain Shield equal to the Shield on Tales to Tell, divided evenly and rounded up to the nearest increment of 5.

skills.name: Mentorship
skills.description: For 3 turns, target ally gains 5 increased damage and 5 Damage Reduction. During this time, the target will gain Elemental Essence if they deal damage, are dealt damage, are stunned, or become invulnerable. Each of these effects may only grant Elemental Essence once.

skills.name: Reading in the Dark
skills.description: Whenever an invisible skill is used, Keeper of Fables adds 10 Shield to Tales to Tell.

skills.name: Tale of Endless Night
skills.description: For 2 turns, any skill used by the allied team is Invisible.

skills.name: Blinding Reveal
skills.description: If Tales to Tell is broken by damage, the attacker is Blinded for 2 turns.

skills.name: Tale of the Coming Dawn
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 40 Shield from Tales to Tell. If successful, he heals all allies for 25 Health.

skills.name: Modernization
skills.description: While Keeper of Fables has Shield remaining on Tales to Tell, he ignores indirect from all sources.

skills.name: Tale of a Distant Future
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 35 Shield from Tales to Tell. If successful, he deals 5 Affliction damage to every character for the rest of the game. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Crackling Hearth
skills.description: Whenever Shield is added to Tales to Tell, Keeper of Fables heals a random allied hero for 10 health.

skills.name: A Tale of Joy and Wonder
skills.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 25 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, then for the next 2 turns, Keeper's allies gain Elemental Essence if they use a new skill.

skills.name: Deepening Shadows
skills.description: At the end of each of her turns, Laria gains a stack of Deepening Shadows. This effect will only trigger if Laria has fewer than 3 stacks.

skills.name: Nightwrap
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy or heals target ally 10 HP, increased by 5 for each stack of Deepening Shadows on them. If the target has Elemental Essence, Laria gains Elemental Essence. Places one stack of Deepening Shadows on the target.

skills.name: Soothing Night
skills.description: Gives all allies 1 stack of Deepening Shadows and heals them for 5 HP. If they already had 4 stacks, they are healed for 10 HP instead. Lasts up to 4 turns.

skills.name: Suffocating Night
skills.description: Gives all enemies 1 stack of Deepening Shadows and deals 5 damage to them. If they already had 4 stacks, this skill deals True damage. Lasts up to 4 turns.

skills.name: Vanish
skills.description: Laria gains 15 Damage Reduction for 3 turns, or until she uses a new skill.

skills.name: Nightfall
skills.description: All characters become invulnerable for 1 turn and take 5 damage or healing for each Deepening Shadows stack they have.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.description: Skills Laria uses while affected by Vanish deal double damage

skills.name: Severance
skills.description: Laria deals 10 Affliction damage to target enemy. Deals 10 more damage for each stack of Deepening Shadows on the target, removing those stacks.

skills.name: Cursed Shadows
skills.description: Cursed units or units with 4 stacks of Deepening Shadows have their skills costs increased by 1 Generic energy. Using a skill will remove 1 stack of Deepening Shadows.

skills.name: Curse of Darkness
skills.description: Target character receives 15 affliction damage and one stack of Deepening Shadows each turn for 3 turns. If they don't use a skill during that time, Curse of Darkness will copy itself to one of their allies at its current duration.

skills.name: In Between
skills.description: If Laria uses Vanish or Nightwrap on herself, she will ignore Harmful effects for 1 turn. This effect has a 2 turn Cooldown.

skills.name: Spirit Away
skills.description: For her next two turns, if Laria triggers In Between, she will also apply its effects to target hero. If they are an enemy, they first receive 25 true damage

skills.name: Dark Matter
skills.description: When Laria uses Vanish, all stacks of Deepening Shadows on the field return to her, dealing 5 damage or healing to the character that had them. This transfer ignores the stack limit on Deepening Shadows.

skills.name: Dark Matter Beam
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy for each stack of Deepening Shadows on Laria. This Consumes Deepening Shadows on use.

skills.name: Black Reflection
skills.description: Whenever another Hero reaches 4 stacks of Deepening Shadows, Laria will swap her current HP with theirs.

skills.name: Shadow Rebound
skills.description: For one turn, the first harmful skill used on target ally is reflected back to its user. This effect is invisible until revealed.

skills.name: Full Moon's Night
skills.description: Nightfall no longer makes characters invulnerable, lasts 4 turns, and causes characters with 3 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows to become Mooncursed. (Mooncursed characters have their Strategic skills stunned, deal 5 more non-affliction damage, and suffer 10 Affliction damage each turn.)

skills.name: Mooncurse
skills.description: Target unit has their Strategic skills stunned, deals 5 more non-Affliction damage, and receivies 10 Affliction damage each turn for 3 turns. This effect cannot be applied to units already affected by it.

skills.name: Deep, Dark Night
skills.description: Once enemy heroes have a total of 10 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows, you can see all invisible effects created by your opponent. Once allied heroes have a total of 10 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows, all allied effects become invisible.

skills.name: Snuff Out
skills.description: Target enemy gains 3 stacks of Deepening Shadows, ignoring the stack limit. Then, if their current health is less than their stacks of Deepening Shadows x 5, Laria will execute them.

skills.name: Shadow Clones
skills.description: Whenever Laria would create one or more stacks of Deepening Shadows, she instead creates a Shadow Clone minion. Shadow Clones are treated as if they are stacks of Deepening Shadows on all targets.

skills.name: Shadow Cross
skills.description: For one turn, the Laria becomes invulnerable for 1 turn, creates a Shadow Clone, and deals 15 Piercing damage to one enemy. Until the end of the turn, Shadow Strike damage to that target is increased by 10.

skills.name: Ritual of Culling Night
skills.description: Laria's Ritual gains 1 Ritual Power for each stack of Deepening Shadows on the field at the end of each turn. Once her Ritual has reached 50 Ritual Power, Laria will consume her Ritual to deal 45 affliction damage to all heroes not affected by Nightcloak Candle.

skills.name: Nightcloak Candle
skills.description: Target ally gains a stack of Deepening Shadows and is marked by Nightcloak Candle permanently. During this time, their skills deal 5 more non-Affliction damage and any enemy who uses a harmful skill on them will take 5 Affliction damage and be marked by Nightcloak Candle for 1 turn. Receiving damage this way generates 5 Ritual Power. This effect does not stack

skills.name: Evencoin
skills.description: Each battle, the first enemy Hero to deal a killing blow receives 1 Evencoin. Characters with Evencoins are treated as though they have triple their actual stacks of Deepening Shadows.

skills.name: Midnight Justice
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If that enemy is above 50 health, their non-strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn. If they have an Evencoin, Midnight Justice deals 10 more damage and has no Cooldown

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Curse of Thorns
skills.description: When Maggie uses a skill, she takes 5 Affliction damage each turn for the rest of the game.

skills.name: Bramblelash
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Until the end of Maggie's next turn, if that target receives new damage, she will gain Elemental Essence

skills.name: Grasping Vines
skills.description: Maggie prepares to cast Grasping Vines on target enemy. The following turn, they receive 15 damage. If the target uses a skill during this time, they are also stunned for 1 turn. The target of this skill is invisible. This effect will be cancelled if Maggie is stunned.

skills.name: Thornburst
skills.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy. If Maggie has 3 or more stacks of Curse of Thorns on her, this skill will target all enemies.

skills.name: Cursed Resistance
skills.description: Maggie gains 10 permanent shield for every stack of Curse of Thorns on her.

skills.name: The Thornborn Witch
skills.description: Maggie ignores damage from Curse of Thorns for 2 turns. During this time, she deals damage equal to her Curse of Thorns damage to all targetable enemies and allies each turn.

skills.name: Blighted Witch
skills.description: When Maggie falls below 70 HP or 30 HP, all enemy skills cost 1 more [65] for 1 turn.

skills.name: Bog Witch's Bargain
skills.description: Targets one enemy for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new skill, they will receive 35 Affliction damage and permanently ignore non-damage effects. If they do not, they are stunned for 1 turn and Maggie heals 35 HP.

skills.name: Thorn Siphon
skills.description: Maggie's allies heal 5 HP each time Curse of Thorns deals damage.

skills.name: Bloodbind
skills.description: For the next 3 turns, Curse of Thorns also damages target enemy.

skills.name: Touch of Finality
skills.description: Units damaged by Curse of Thorns cannot be healed for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shared Fate
skills.description: Target enemy is permanently affected by Curse of Thorns.

skills.name: Asmodeus's Promise
skills.description: Once Maggie has at least 5 stacks of Curse of Thorns, she applies it to any enemy she damages.

skills.name: Lust for Power
skills.description: Maggie gains 1 stack of Curse of Thorns and Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Sweet Torment
skills.description: Whenever Maggie deals damage to an ally, she deals 5 more non-Affliction damage permanently.

skills.name: Transferance Contract
skills.description: Target ally receives all stacks of Curse of Thorns currently on Maggie.

skills.name: Spectral Growth
skills.description: Whenever an enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 stack of Spectral Growth. Maggie's damaging skills will remove these stacks to heal her for 5 HP per stack.

skills.name: Ghostlash
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 if they are currently marked by Bramblelash. Bypassing

skills.name: Graveyard Wanderer
skills.description: Maggie gains 10 Damage Reduction for each dead Hero in the battle.

skills.name: Bloodrose Offering
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target ally dies, Maggie will heal 10 HP for each stack of Curse of Thorns on her. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: Lash of Servitude
skills.description: If Maggie kills an enemy Hero, she creates a Revenant minion with their 3 Basic skills and 25 HP.

skills.name: Icebite Briars
skills.description: For 4 turns, if Maggie deals damage to an enemy, that enemy will deal 5 less non-Affliction damage for 1 turn. During this time, Curse of Thorns will not damage her.

skills.name: Manipulated Movements
skills.description: If Maggie is affected with a new stun effect, she receives 1 stack of Curse of Thorns and removes that stun effect.

skills.name: Bloody Marionette
skills.description: For the next 3 turns, target ally will become Immortal. During this time, they can only target Maggie or enemies affected by Bramblelash. At the end of this skill's duration, the target dies.

skills.name: Sanguine Craving
skills.description: Maggie now receives an additional stack of Curse of Thorns when she uses a skill, and will receive 1 stack if she does not act on her turn.

skills.name: Thousand Lashes
skills.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 per stack of Curse of Thorns on Maggie.

skills.name: Burning Up
skills.description: When an enemy affected by Fan the Flames damages Pyrrha, she gains Elemental Essence. When Pyrrha dies, she deals 10 Affliction damage to all targetable enemies.

skills.name: Fan the Flames
skills.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to target enemy, then 5 Affliction damage for the next 3 turns. Using this skill on an affected enemy will refresh the duration.

skills.name: Feed the Fire
skills.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to target enemy affected by Fan the Flames. Pyrrha heals 10 HP and gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Pyrokinesis
skills.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy. If the target is affected by Fan the Flames, they take 5 more damage from it for the rest of its duration.

skills.name: Flashbang
skills.description: Stuns target enemy's non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. Pyrrha becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Wraith in White
skills.description: Pyrrha ignores non-damage effects for 2 turns. During this time, using Pyrokinesis on an enemy will first use Fan the Flames.

skills.name: Alchemist's Fire
skills.description: Dealing damage to an enemy while Pyrrha has Bottled Flame will apply an additional 5 Affliction damage for 4 turns.

skills.name: Bottled Flame
skills.description: Removes Fan the Flames from target enemy, giving Pyrrha Elemental Essence and a Bottled Flame for 3 turns.

skills.name: Ice Age
skills.description: Damaging an enemy with Feed the Fire now also lowers the target's damage by 5 for their next 2 turns.

skills.name: Extinction Event
skills.description: Deals 35 damage to all enemies, and for 1 turn, if that enemy becomes invulnerable, they are stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Festering Burns
skills.description: Fan the Flames is now permanent and stacks, but is no longer affected by Pyrokinesis.

skills.name: Sulphur Vent
skills.description: Counters the first enemy to use a skill on Pyrrha for 1 turn. If an enemy is successfully countered this way, they have a stack of Fan the Flames added to them.

skills.name: Flames of Greed
skills.description: Fan the Flames now affects all enemies, but also affects all allies.

skills.name: Mammon's Flame
skills.description: Deals 40 Affliction damage to one enemy and 20 Affliction damage to Pyrrha. This skill costs 1 more [65] and deals 10 more damage to the target and Pyrrha each time it is used.

skills.name: Dragon's Hunger
skills.description: Pyrrha deals 5 more damage and healing with Feed the Fire, and it targets all enemies currently affected by Fan the Flames.

skills.name: Flame of Legends
skills.description: Deals 25 Affliction damage to one enemy and applies the damage-over-time portion of Fan the Flames. While Pyrrha is at or below 30 HP, this skill targets all enemies.

skills.name: Flames of Judgment
skills.description: Receiving damage from Fan the Flames or using a skill on Pyrrha or her allies gives enemies a stack of Flames of Judgment.

skills.name: Judgment Day
skills.description: Target enemy with 7 or more stacks of Flames of Judgment is instantly killed. This skill Bypasses and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Exhaust Fumes
skills.description: Enemies affected by Fan the Flames receive 10 Affliction damage if they target Pyrrha with a new skill.

skills.name: Blastoff
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies and makes Pyrrha invulnerable for 2 turns, or until she uses a new skill.

skills.name: Burning Plasma
skills.description: Fan the Flames now Shatters the affected enemy for its duration.

skills.name: Ivory Cutter
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the enemy is Shattered, they take an additional 5 damage and Pyrrha gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Ritual of Agony
skills.description: Pyrrha's Ritual gains 4 Ritual Power whenever a unit receives damage or dies. When this effect reaches 75 Ritual Power, all units will permanently receive double damage (this effect does not stack).

skills.name: Tormentor's Brand
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to an enemy or an ally and sets their max HP to their current HP.

skills.name: Solar Flare
skills.description: Flashbang now costs [13] but affects all enemies.

skills.name: Scorched Earth
skills.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to all enemy Heroes. If they are affected by Fan the Flames, this skill deals an additional 10 damage and removes Elemental Essence from them.

skills.name: Healing Tears
skills.description: Whenever River Daughter counters or stuns an enemy, she heals her team for 5 HP every turn for 3 turns. Whenever this occurs, she gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Ripple
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to the enemy team. The following turn, Undertow will stun its target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Undertow
skills.description: Target enemy receives 20 damage.

skills.name: River Clone
skills.description: Counters the first harmful skill used by target enemy. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: Soothe
skills.description: Heals an ally for 10 health each turn for 2 turns. After the heal, if the target is a Hero and has full HP or less than 60 HP, River Daughter gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Dive
skills.description: River Daughter becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. The following turn, Ripple will last two turns, Undertow will target all enemies, and River Clone's cost is changed to [65].

skills.name: Unstable Waters
skills.description: Undertow now increases the damage taken by the target by 5 for 2 turns.

skills.name: Mystic Essence
skills.description: Heals an ally for 10 health and increases all of their damage by 5 for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fountain of Youth
skills.description: The target of Soothe is now also cleansed of all enemy effects.

skills.name: Waters of Life
skills.description: Heals all allies and minions for 10 health for the next 3 turns.

skills.name: Blood in the Water
skills.description: River Daughter stores all of the damage she deals to the enemy team. Whenever Healing Tears triggers, she heals her team for 10 additional health for every 40 damage stored, emptying the stored damage.

skills.name: Run Red
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for every 20 damage stored in Blood in the Water, emptying the stored damage. This skill does not add damage to Blood in the Water.

skills.name: Conducted Emotion
skills.description: Healing Tears now lasts one turn and heals 10 health, but it also activates whenever she gains Elemental Essence from another source. Triggering Healing Tears this way will not give River Daughter Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Catalytic Nova
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to the enemy team and increases the damage of your next Ripple by 10, stacking infinitely. If this skill is used again on the following turn, River Daughter gains Elemental Essence

skills.name: Winter Flow
skills.description: Soothe now heals the ally for 5 health on the first turn, 10 health on the second, and 15 on the third turn.

skills.name: Spring Thaw
skills.description: Grants an ally 20 shield for 1 turn. The following turn, they gain 10 shield for 1 turn.

skills.name: Reflection of Kindness
skills.description: River Daughter stores all healing received by the enemy team. Each time she accumulates 50 total healing, she gains Elemental Essence and deals 15 Affliction damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Party Crasher
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. This skill deals bonus damage equal to the healing the target received last round.

skills.name: Shallows Dance
skills.description: River Daughter starts each round under the effect of Dive, but it no longer makes her invulnerable. Instead, while Dive is active, River Daughter deals 10 piercing damage to any enemy that uses a harmful skill.

skills.name: Shallow Slash
skills.description: Deals 15 piercing damage to target enemy. If used from Dive, this skill reactivates Dive.

skills.name: Triton's Blessing
skills.description: Healing Tears is now triggered whenever an enemy uses a Strategic skill. Heroes can only have one heal-over-time effect from Triton's Blessing at a time.

skills.name: Atlantean Assault
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy until River Daughter stops Channeling.

skills.name: Toxic Waste
skills.description: Any overhealing done by River Daughter is dealt to a random enemy as Affliction damage.

skills.name: Chemical Bath
skills.description: Stuns target enemy's Strategic skills for 1 turn. If used from Dive, this skill stuns for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Bubbling Mire
skills.description: River Daughter begins each round with two Slime minions. Enemies who deal new damage to Slime minions receive 5 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Congeal
skills.description: Restores 15HP to all Slime Minions. Any healing past max is added as Max HP. This skill is automatically cast whenever Healing Tears activates.

skills.name: Corrosive Slam
skills.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to the enemy team on the following turn. If this unit takes damage, this skill is cancelled.

skills.name: Living Stone
skills.description: At the end of each of his turns, Roland gives 10 Shield to a random ally. If this Shield is broken, Roland gains Elemental Essence

skills.name: Strength From The Earth
skills.description: Targets an enemy or Boulder, dealing 15 damage to them, increased by 10 if he is affected by Living Stone. If the target is a Boulder, it will launch at a random enemy, dealing its remaining health in damage before being destroyed. If there is a character Marked by Earth Pillar, the launched Boulder will prioritize targeting that character.

skills.name: Earth Pillar
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and marks them with an Earth Pillar for Roland's next two turns. If this ability strikes a stunned target, they are Shattered for 2 turns.

skills.name: Form Stone
skills.description: Creates a Boulder minion.

skills.name: Stoneform
skills.description: Roland gains 15 points of Damage Reduction for 1 turn. Any targets affected by Living Stone are also affected.

skills.name: Fissure
skills.description: All targets other than Roland take 20 damage and have their Harmful skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill starts each round with 2 turns of cooldown remaining.

skills.name: Cairnstones
skills.description: Whenever a non-Boulder, non-Zombie ally dies, Roland creates a Boulder minion.

skills.name: Call the Honored Dead
skills.description: Consumes all active Boulder minions to create that many Zombie minions.

skills.name: Living Boulder
skills.description: Boulder minions now have Living Lash.

skills.name: Mother Stone's Embrace
skills.description: For the next 2 turns, all allied units are affected by Living Stone each turn.

skills.name: Mag-Lev Pillars
skills.description: Boulders gain 15 Shield for 2 turns whenever an enemy is affected by Earth Pillar.

skills.name: Magnetize Munitions
skills.description: Target Boulder taunts all enemies for 1 turn. On the following turn, that Boulder will deal double damage to any enemy it damages.

skills.name: Moonfield
skills.description: Each time Earth Pillar has been used or a Boulder has been launched with Strength From The Earth, Roland gains one stack of Stonefield Stalker.

skills.name: Stonefield Stalker
skills.description: Roland consumes all stacks of Stonefield Stalker. He becomes Mooncursed for a number of turns equal to 1 + the number of stacks consumed, and during this time Strength from the Earth deals 15 additional damage to targets affected by Earth Pillar.

skills.name: Spires of the North
skills.description: Earth Pillar can now be used on allies, giving them 15 permanent Shield and making them invulnerable to Strategic skills for 2 turns.

skills.name: Troll Stonethrower
skills.description: Creates a Troll Stonethrower minion.

skills.name: Mark the Path
skills.description: Enemies damaged by Boulders are permanently marked by Mark the Path. Allies Bypass when targeting enemies affected by Mark the Path.

skills.name: FInal Warning
skills.description: Roland casts Strength From The Earth on all enemy heroes marked by Mark the Path and all active Boulders.

skills.name: Soothing Stone
skills.description: Allies affected by Living Stone's shield heal 5 HP each turn.

skills.name: Sanctus Terra
skills.description: Deals 45 damage to the enemy team. Can only be used if Roland has exactly 4 Boulder minions.

skills.name: Oozeshaping
skills.description: Creating Boulder minionss now instead creates two Slimeball minions. Strength from the Earth can be used to launch a Slimeball like it's a Boulder, stunning any enemy damaged by it.

skills.name: Call to the Mire
skills.description: For 2 turns, Slimeball minions are immune to damage and one will be created each turn.

skills.name: Scattered Spores
skills.description: Whenever a Boulder is destroyed, create a Stonecap Mushroom minion. If Roland uses Strength from the Earth on a Stonecap Mushroom, he deals 15 Affliction damage to all enemy units, destroying the Stonecap Mushroom.

skills.name: Loamwrecker
skills.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. If Roland controls more Boulders than Stonecap Mushrooms, this damage is Piercing and grants him 15 Shield. If he controls more Stonecap Mushrooms than Boulders, this damage is Affliction and heals him for 10 Health.

skills.name: Exposure
skills.description: Enemies marked by Earth Pillar receive 10 Affliction damage per turn that they remain marked.

skills.name: Molten Rockslide
skills.description: Launches all active Boulders at target enemy affected by Earth Pillar, dealing 20 Affliction damage per Boulder.

skills.name: Living Lash
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Hurl
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. Deals 20 more damage if there is an existing Boulder, destroying the Boulder in the process. Deals 10 more damage if the user is affected by an Earth Pillar.

skills.name: Shambling Smash
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. Using this skill does not deactivate Exile.

skills.name: Well-Used Panic Button
skills.description: The first time Saya falls below 40 health due to damage, her next Stroke of Genius will detonate all of her inventions, dealing 10 Piercing damage to a random enemy and granting her 10 Shield for each device detonated.

skills.name: Universal Energy Conduit
skills.description: Gives a random ally Elemental Essence at the end of Saya's turns. While Enhanced, lowers the cost of the targeted ally's skills by [65] for 1 turn.

skills.name: Saya Coil
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to a random enemy at the end of every turn. While Enhanced, this skill deals double damage. Saya can only have up to 3 Saya Coils active at a time.

skills.name: Spider Mines
skills.description: Saya constructs two spider mines that then attach to random enemy Heroes. If those enemies use a new skill, their spider mine detonates, dealing 15 damage. While Enhanced, three Spider Mines are created instead.

skills.name: Plasma Shield
skills.description: Saya gains 40 shield and ignores affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible. While Enhanced, damage to her Shield will grant her Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Stroke of Genius
skills.description: Saya gains Elemental Essence and changes the costs of her other skills to 1 [3], Enhancing her next skill.

skills.name: Prismatic Shielding
skills.description: Plasma Shield now affects all allied Heroes, and lasts 2 turns.

skills.name: Prismatic Energy Cannon
skills.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to target enemy. This skill deals 10 more damage for each stack of Universal Energy Conduit on Saya.

skills.name: Storage Capacitor
skills.description: Saya gains an additional [65] every turn.

skills.name: Saya Cell
skills.description: Creates a Saya Cell minion.

skills.name: Constant Flux
skills.description: Saya Coil deals a random amount between 10 less and 10 more damage than its base (in increments of 5).

skills.name: Flux Injector
skills.description: Target ally deals 5 more non-Affliction damage and gains Elemental Essence each turn for 2 turns.

skills.name: Miniature Ion Cannons
skills.description: Saya Coils can no longer be Enhanced and gain a maximum stack of 2, but are applied 2 at a time. Well-Used Panic Button will no longer consider or destroy Saya Coils.

skills.name: Polarity Ray
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, and causes any active Saya Coils to immediately fire at them as well.

skills.name: Magnetic Field
skills.description: Whenever an enemy uses a Helpful or Harmful skill, they will gain positive or negative charge. If an enemy uses a Harmful skill while negatively charged or vice versa, they will receive 15 damage and be stunned for 1 turn. Using a Strategic skill removes all charge.

skills.name: Personal Magnetism
skills.description: Saya counters the first Helpful or Harmful skill used by target enemy for 1 turn. If successful, the target loses Elemental Essence and gains a Magnetic Charge matching the countered skill.

skills.name: Direct Energy Line
skills.description: Whenever Saya gains Elemental Essence, she heals 10 Health. Saya cannot be healed in any other way.

skills.name: Plasma Cannon
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. The turn after Direct Energy Line triggers, this skill deals 10 more damage and becomes Piercing.

skills.name: Shady Assistants
skills.description: Saya begins the round with a Shady Assistant minion.

skills.name: Saya-Brand Monstrosity
skills.description: Creates a Monstrosity minion. This skill costs one less [60] for each dead allied Hero, and one fewer [65] for each dead enemy Hero. Limit 1.

skills.name: Charged Environment
skills.description: Saya Coils now deal 10 damage to a second random enemy when they deal damage

skills.name: Lightning Rod
skills.description: Saya will deal 5 damage to a random enemy per stack of Lightning Rod on her. She will gain a stack of Lightning Rod whenever Saya gains energy from Elemental Essence. Cannot be used once active.

skills.name: Reverberation
skills.description: When Saya damages a character, they deal 5 reduced damage permanently, stacking. This effect is removed if the target becomes invulnerable.

skills.name: Saya Shrieker
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to a target, Bypassing. If the target is invulnerable, they take 10 additional damage and are stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Overwatch
skills.description: Dealing damage to allied Heroes marks the enemy with Overwatch  for 2 turn.

skills.name: Orbital Strike
skills.description: Deals 20 Bypassing damage to all enemies marked by Overwatch

skills.name: Channel Earth
skills.description: Generates 1 Energy of Gaia's current Element.

skills.name: Divert Charge
skills.description: Target Hero gains Elemental Essence. After using this skill, the Saya Cell minion dies.

skills.name: Busy Work
skills.description: Reduces the cost of Saya's skills by 1 Generic for her next 2 turns.

skills.name: Mad Mash
skills.description: The Monstrosity deals 40 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Embedded Restoration
skills.description: Heals the Monstrosity for 15 HP.

skills.name: The Devil's Price
skills.description: Whenever a target triggers one of Scratch's Deal skills, Scratch gains Elemental Essence. When one of his Deal skills expires without being triggered, its target gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Deal: Defeat Your Enemies
skills.description: Target Hero deals 10 more non-Affliction damage for 1 turn. If they use a new skill, that Hero will receive 20 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Deal: Save Your Friends
skills.description: For 1 turn, target Hero's next Helpful skill will heal its targets for 15 HP and make them Invulnerable for 1 turn. If they use a new skill, this effect will end and that Hero will be permanently Isolated.

skills.name: Deal: Realize Your Potential
skills.description: Until the end of their next turn, Target Hero's skills cost 1 less Specific and 1 less Generic energy. If they use a new skill, they will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Faustian Bargain
skills.description: Scratch's next deal will not apply its positive effect to enemies, and will not apply its Triggered effect to allies.

skills.name: Disarming Pitch
skills.description: For 1 turn, Scratch gains 10 Shield and any enemy who users a new skill on him will be marked for 1 turn. Scratch's Deal skills always apply to marked Heroes.

skills.name: Deal: Know Your Fate
skills.description: For 3 turns, target Hero ignores non-damage effects and their skills have no cost. At the end of this duration, that Hero is killed.

skills.name: Eyes of Vengeance
skills.description: Enemy Heroes who use non-Invisible Harmful skills on Sera or her allies gain a stack of Eyes of Vengeance.

skills.name: Synthetic Skyblade
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If they are marked by Eyes of Vengeance, this skill will consume 1 stack to deal 10 additional damage and grant Sera Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Energized Wingstorm
skills.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to the enemy team. If any enemies are marked by Eyes of Vengeance, this skill will consume 1 stack from each to reduce this skill's cooldown by 1 turn for each marked consumed.

skills.name: Heavenly Parry
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a new Harmful skill, they will take 25 Piercing damage and gain an additional stack of Eyes of Vengeance. This effect is invisible. If the target was already marked, Sera gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Scan of the All-Knowing
skills.description: Eyes of Vengeance will trigger from Strategic skills as well for 1 turn. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: Proactivity Protocol
skills.description: Sera receives 20 True Damage and 20 Shield. Target ally is healed for 20 HP.

skills.name: Divinity Engine
skills.description: For her next 2 turns, Sera ignores non-damage effects. During this time, Synthetic Skyblade will consume an additional stack of Eyes of Vengeance if possible, and grants Sera Shield equal to the damage it deals. This skill's cost is decreased by S for each of Sera's dead allies.
