skills.name: Two as One
skills.description: Syl begins the game with a Hatchling Eagle minion. Any time Syl and her Eagle act on the same turn, she gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Feed
skills.description: Syl heals her Eagle minion for 20 health. If her Eagle minion is at maximum life after the heal, she gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Skylance
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: To the Skies!
skills.description: This turn, Talon Rake will stun its target for 1 turn, and Soar will last an additional turn and extend this effect. When empowered this way, Talon Rake has its cooldown increased by 1.

skills.name: Unbreakable Bond
skills.description: Equalizes the health between Syl and her Eagle minion

skills.name: Leyline Nest
skills.description: Advances Syl's Eagle Minion to the next growth stage. This skill costs 1 less [4] each turn, resetting on use.

skills.name: Shieldmaiden
skills.description: Skylance now taunts its target and gives Syl 10 Shield for 1 turn.

skills.name: Divine Lance
skills.description: Deals 35 True damage to target enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Great Roc
skills.description: Syl's Eagle minion's skills cost 1 more [65], but last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Sky Drop
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and stuns them for 0 turns. This skill deals 10 more damage and stuns for 1 more turn per stage her Eagle has evolved this round.

skills.name: Harrier
skills.description: Syl and her Eagle minion deal 5 less damage with their skills, but any time they damage an enemy, they become Invulnerable to Strategic skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sparrowrider Cohort
skills.description: Syl summons 2 Sparrowrider minions. Sparrowrider minions count as Syl's Eagle minion for triggering Two as One.

skills.name: Silent Wingbeats
skills.description: Syl and her Eagle now Bypass against Isolated targets

skills.name: Forlorn Feathers
skills.description: All units are Isolated for 4 turns. During this time, Syl will not gain stacks of Leyline Nest's cost reduction.

skills.name: The Aerie
skills.description: Syl begins the game with 25 Shield. While this Shield holds, Syl will always trigger Two as One when she uses a skill (even if she acts alone).

skills.name: The Grand Finale
skills.description: Syl deals 35 Affliction damage to target enemy, plus the value of Shield remaining on The Aerie. After using this skill, if Syl's Eagle has not used Swoop on that same enemy, Syl dies.

skills.name: Flutter in the Fog
skills.description: At the end of her turn, Syl becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. If she became invulnerable this way on her last turn, her Eagle becomes invulnerable for 1 turn instead. The turn after making her Eagle invulnerable, this effect will not activate.

skills.name: Falling Leaf
skills.description: Deals 40 Piercing damage to target enemy. Can only be used on the turn when Flutter in the Fog is inactive.

skills.name: Eaglehawk Rider
skills.description: Using To the Skies! makes Syl invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Seekers
skills.description: Marks all enemies for 2 turns. During this time, if they receive new damage from Syl or her Eagle minion, their non-Strategic skills will be stunned for 1 turn and the mark is removed.

skills.name: Scavenger's Path
skills.description: Any time an ally or an enemy dies, they create a Scavenger's Pile minion. If Syl's Eagle minion kills a Scavenger's Pile, her Eagle heals 25 HP and Leyline Nest costs 1 less [30] until it is used.

skills.name: Pick the Bones
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If this skill kills its target, Syl's team gains Elemental Essence. This skill's base damage doubles if it targets a Scavenger's Pile.

skills.name: Stormchaser
skills.description: Leyline Nest's cost no longer decreases by 1 [35] each turn. Instead, its cost is decreased by 1 [35] each time she gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Lightning Crash
skills.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy, Bypassing. For her next 3 turns, Skylance will deal 5 Piercing damage to 2 additional, random targets and grant Syl Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Mountain Rescue Team
skills.description: Feed can now target any stunned ally. Swoop can now be used to make a stunned ally invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Search and Rescue
skills.description: For the next 4 turns, anytime an ally is stunned, Syl will heal them for 20 HP and make them invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Nettle Strike
skills.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Talon Rake
skills.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Swoop
skills.description: Target enemy becomes Shattered until the end of the turn. This turn, Skylance will deal an additional 15 damage.

skills.name: Soar
skills.description: This unit and Syl become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Protector of the Song
skills.description: When Taryn has an ability reflected to him, he gains 10 DR for 1 turn and Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Banner of Harmony
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. For 1 turns, any Harmful skill used by the target is reflected to Taryn.

skills.name: Refrain
skills.description: Targets one enemy or ally. If used on an enemy, stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn. If used on an ally, they are healed for 15 health whenever they use a skill for 2 turns.

skills.name: Inspiring Thrust
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. This turn, any ally who uses a new harmful skill on the target will gain Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Stalwart Shield
skills.description: May target Taryn or an ally. Grants Taryn 20 Shield, and if used on an ally, reflects all harmful skills from the target to himself. This skill's target is invisible.

skills.name: Radiant Glory
skills.description: For 3 turns, using Stalwart Shield and Inspiring Thrust will also use Refrain on the target.

skills.name: Skyward Shield
skills.description: Stalwart Shield now makes Taryn and any targeted allies Invulnerable for 1 turn, and gives Taryn Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Hand of Michael
skills.description: The following turn, target enemy will receive 30 Damage. If the enemy uses a harmful skill during this time it will be Countered, and Hand of Michael will deal an additional 15 damage.

skills.name: Flow of Inspiration
skills.description: Inspiring Thrust now lasts for 2 turns, and also heals allies who activate its effect for 10 Health.

skills.name: Font of Glory
skills.description: Taryn grants target ally Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Purifying Shield
skills.description: When Stalwart Shield ends, Taryn and any affected allies are healed 5 health for each enemy effect affecting them.

skills.name: That Which Ails Me
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and cleanses them of one beneficial effect.

skills.name: Divine Hymn
skills.description: The Damage Reduction from Protector of the Song now lasts for 2 turns and affects both of Taryn's allies as well.

skills.name: Holy Word: Peace
skills.description: Target enemy has their Harmful skills stunned for 2 turns. If the target receives new damage during this time, the stun will end. This skill is cast in place of Refrain during Radiant Glory.

skills.name: Forced Harmony
skills.description: If a target affected by Banner of Harmony deals new damage to Taryn's allies, they receive double damage from Taryn's next Inspiring Thrust.

skills.name: Trial by Fire
skills.description: Deals 15 Damage to target enemy for the next 2 turns. During this time, the target is Isolated.

skills.name: Refracted Refrain
skills.description: Healing from Refrain now affects Taryn's entire team.

skills.name: Do Unto Others
skills.description: Target ally gains 20 Shield. If the targeted ally is affected by Refrain, this skill will affect all allies. This extra effect ignores Isolation.

skills.name: Guardian at the Gates
skills.description: Protector of the Song now activates every turn. This effect is disabled for 1 turn if Taryn deals damage.

skills.name: Banner of  Consecration
skills.description: For 2 turns, damaging Taryn or his allies will cause the attacker to receive 10 damage. This damage will not disable Guardian at the Gates.

skills.name: Wingman
skills.description: Stalwart Shield no longer grants Taryn Shield, is fully Invisible, and reflects skills back at their user instead.

skills.name: Not Today
skills.description: Taryn reflects all harmful skills from target ally to himself for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Glorious Justice
skills.description: If Taryn's team has fewer living Heroes than the enemy team, his skills deal 10 additional damage and have their damage changed to Piercing.

skills.name: Restrain
skills.description: Stuns Taryn and target enemy for 1 turn. If Taryn receives new damage during this time, Restrain will permanently last 1 turn longer on the damaging enemy.

skills.name: Flag of Inquisition
skills.description: Protector of the Song no longer gives Taryn Damage Reduction, instead increasing his damage by 10 until the end of his next turn. This effect can stack.

skills.name: Verse of Accusation
skills.description: Taryn activates Protector of the Song and until the end of his next turn,  Banner of Harmony will affect all enemies.

skills.name: Whimsy
skills.description: Titania's skills do not trigger effects with their use or damage.

skills.name: Thorn Prick
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy and 5 affliction damage permanently.

skills.name: Laughing Powder
skills.description: Target enemy has their strategic skills stunned for 2 turns and takes 5 affliction damage per turn. Anyone who uses a new skill on that character is afflicted by Laughing Powder for 2 turns.

skills.name: Barbed Wit
skills.description: Titania taunts target enemy for 3 turns. This effect will end if they use a new harmful skill on Titania

skills.name: Prance
skills.description: Titania gains Elemental Essence. For one turn, the first unit to use a new skill on Titania gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Summer Clique
skills.description: For each time Titania has gained or given Elemental Essence with Prance this game, she creates a Summer Courtesan minion. Stacks will reset on use.

skills.name: Capricious Cornucopia
skills.description: When Titania uses Prance, Gift from the Fae changes to its beneficial version. When she uses a harmful skill on an enemy, it changes to its harmful version.

skills.name: Gift from the Fae
skills.description: If in its beneficial version, heals its target for 20 HP for 2 turns. If in its harmful version, any healing the target receives for the next 3 turns is dealt as Affliction damage instead. This skill starts the game in its beneficial form.

skills.name: Sealed Fate
skills.description: Damage from Thorn Prick or its periodic effect will instantly kill minions if their HP falls below 20 from the hit.

skills.name: Drop of Moonglove
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy receives healing, they will permanently ignore healing and receive 15 Affliction damage each turn for the rest of the round. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: Arcadian Advancement
skills.description: Each time an ally triggers Prance, Titania's effects will permanently last an additional turn.

skills.name: The Whimsy Engine
skills.description: For the next 1 turn, any time a unit uses a new skill, they will instead use a random one of their skills with randomly selected targets.

skills.name: Five Plagues
skills.description: Titania begins each round with 5 stacks of Five Plagues. Whenever an enemy receives Affliction damage from Titania, they have a 10% chance per stack to receive a random one of the following effects: skill costs increased by [65] for 1 turn, Shattered for 1 turn, non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn, Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn, Isolated for 1 turn.

skills.name: Locust Swarm
skills.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to all enemies. Removes one stack of Five Plagues from Titania with each use

skills.name: Barren Realm
skills.description: Titania now also generates one stack of Summer Clique any time she takes damage. Whenever she would create a Summer Courtesan, she instead deals 10 Affliction damage to the enemy target with the lowest HP (random if tied). This effect Bypasses invulnerability.

skills.name: Arcadia, Enraged
skills.description: All enemies receive 5 Affliction damage each turn for 4 turns. During this time, Thorn Prick has no cost and its initial damage is increased by 5.

skills.name: Compound Eyes
skills.description: Titania can no longer by Blinded, Stunned, or have her costs changed.

skills.name: Hive Formation
skills.description: For 4 turns, target ally gains Compound Eyes. During this time, if Titania uses Barbed Wit, the Taunt effect redirects to a random ally with Hive Formation.

skills.name: Summer Queen
skills.description: While Titania has a Summer Courtesan, she cannot be targeted by harmful skills.

skills.name: Burning Order
skills.description: Target Summer Courtesan deals triple damage this turn.

skills.name: Weaponized Mirth
skills.description: Laughing Powder's damage over time is doubled, and when it transfers to a new target, the current target receives 15 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Hysteria Serum
skills.description: Target enemy is permanently Isolated, and receives 20 Affliction damage if they use a Helpful skill.

skills.name: Hallucinogenic Spores
skills.description: Enemies affected by Barbed Wit or Laughing Powder have their non-Strategic skill costs increased by [65]. This effect does not stack.

skills.name: Raving Madness
skills.description: All enemies affected by Hallucinogenic Spores take 10 Affliction damage for 2 turns. This effect Bypasses invulnerability.

skills.name: Winter Exile
skills.description: Titania can no longer create Summer Courtesan minions. When she uses Summer Clique, she instead creates Winter Loyalist minions.

skills.name: Icy Smile
skills.description: If target enemy receives new damage this turn, they are stunned and the damaging ally receives Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Curry Favor
skills.description: Heals Titania for 15 HP.

skills.name: Diving Slash
skills.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Exile Slash
skills.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy. For the rest of the turn, if that enemy receives damage from a Winter Loyalist, they will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Prismari Rangers
skills.description: Prisma Trinity is split between three members: Prisma Crimson, Prisma Azure, and Prisma Saffron. This Hero is Untargetable and ignores damage and Harmful effects, and is considered to be dead when all three members are dead.

skills.name: Prisma Lens
skills.description: Targets 1 enemy. Members of the Prismari can target the user of this skill to reflect their own skills to the targeted enemy, amplified. Reflecting skills this way gives Prisma Trinity Elemental Essence. Ruby Lens, Sapphire Lens, Citrine Lens

skills.name: Prisma Maneuver
skills.description: The Prismari have a variety of reactive and defensive skills they can use on either themselves or another Prismari Ranger. Prisma Vault, Prisma Whirl, Prisma Launch

skills.name: Chroma Magica
skills.description: The Prismari can fire magical attacks at their enemies or other Prismari Rangers. Crimson Crash, Sonata Azure, Saffron Beam

skills.name: Sapphire Lens
skills.description: Prisma Azure prepares to redirect a teammate towards a targeted enemy. If a skill is redirected this way, the affected ally is healed for 10 HP. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Prisma Whirl
skills.description: For one turn, the first enemy to use a Harmful skill will receive 10 Piercing damage. If used on another Prismari Ranger that is using their Lens, that unit will become Invulnerable for 1 turn and Prisma Whirl's effect can damage any number of enemies.

skills.name: Sonata Azure
skills.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ruby Lens
skills.description: Prisma Crimson prepares to redirect a teammate towards a targeted enemy. If a skill is redirected this way, the targeted enemy receives 5 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Prisma Vault
skills.description: Prisma Crimson becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. If used on another Prisma Ranger that is using their Lens, the enemy they are targeting is marked for 1 turn. Crimson Crash deals 15 more damage to enemies marked by Prisma Vault.

skills.name: Crimson Crash
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Citrine Lens
skills.description: Prisma Citrine prepares to redirect a teammate towards a targeted enemy. If a skill is redirected this way, the targeted enemy deals 5 less damage for 1 turn.

skills.name: Prisma Launch
skills.description: Until the end of the next turn, Prisma Saffron's skills will Bypass against target enemy. If used on another Prisma Ranger that is using their Lens, their skills will also Bypass during this time and they become invulnerable for one turn.

skills.name: Saffron Beam
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dream Body
skills.description: Whenever this Hero is the sole target of a skill, he gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Reveal Hidden Truth
skills.description: Xyris deals 15 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Enter the Dreamscape
skills.description: Xyris deals 20 damage to target enemy and stuns their helpful skills for 2 turns. While active, Xyris gains Elemental Essence each turn.

skills.name: Twisted Nightmares
skills.description: Xyris deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, their AOE skills become single-target.

skills.name: Somnic Apparition
skills.description: Xyris counters the next Harmful skill used by target enemy for 1 turn. If countered this way, Xyris creates a Dream Reflection minion (HP:35) with a copy of the countered skill (its Specific costs change to Xyris' current Element.) This effect is invisible.

skills.name: Echoes of Desire
skills.description: The next skill used by target ally will occur twice. Cannot target Xyris.

skills.name: Before I Wake
skills.description: When Enter the Dreamscape ends, affected enemies receive damage equal to the damage they received while it was active.

skills.name: Dream Knife
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to an enemy affected by Enter the Dreamscape.

skills.name: Hypnagogic Curse
skills.description: Xyris now starts the game at 1HP. Damage now heals him, and healing damages him. Xyris will now die when he reaches 100 HP.

skills.name: Dream Weaving
skills.description: Xyris and a targeted Hero swap their current HP.

skills.name: Dreamform Paradox
skills.description: Whenever Dream Body triggers, the cooldown on Astral Rejection and Somnic Apparition are reduced by 1.

skills.name: Astral Rejection
skills.description: Target Hero is Banished (Stunned, Untargetable, Invulnerable) for 1 turn. This effect cancels any skills that they had delayed.

skills.name: Dark Arcadia
skills.description: Enter the Dreamscape now affects all living units.

skills.name: Phantasia Pulse
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each hero with Elemental Essence on the enemy team. Xyris is healed for 10 HP for each hero with Elemental Essence on his team.

skills.name: Darkness and Truth
skills.description: Simulacrums and Dream Reflections ignore counters and stuns.

skills.name: Simulacrum
skills.description: Xyris targets one ally or enemy and creates a Simulacrum minion that possesses their Basic skills. Simulacrums are created with 30 HP and their specific costs are the same as Xyris's.

skills.name: Captured Humanity
skills.description: Enemies countered by Dream Reflection are permanently Mooncursed. (Mooncursed characters have their Strategic skills stunned, deal 5 more non-affliction damage, and suffer 10 Affliction damage each turn.)

skills.name: Wild Hunt
skills.description: Xyris targets all Mooncursed units. For 3 turns, they are Shattered and Isolated. Allied targets deal 5 more non-Affliction damage with new skills.

skills.name: Quiet Nightmare
skills.description: Xyris will Silence enemies that he damages for 1 turn.

skills.name: Spine Chill
skills.description: Xyris deals 20 damage to all enemies and Paralyzes their cooldowns for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dream Infiltration
skills.description: Enter the Dreamscape no longer deals damage, but targets all enemies. Xyris's skills Bypass against targets affected by Enter the Dreamscape.

skills.name: Steal Secrets
skills.description: Xyris targets one enemy and creates a Dream Reflection minion with a copy of the skill that the targeted enemy used last. Can only be used on a target affected by Enter the Dreamscape, and will fail if the target has not yet used a skill.

skills.name: Shadow Court Ritual
skills.description: Any time Elemental Essence is gained, Xyris gains 5 Ritual Power. After reaching 75 Ritual Power, all units have their skill cooldowns reduced by 1.

skills.name: Heartfire
skills.description: Target unit receives 20 Affliction damage. Xyris and the target both gain Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Dreams of Power
skills.description: Xyris deals 5 more damage to enemies with Elemental Essence, and gains Elemental Essence when using Harmful skills on them.

skills.name: Sacred Severing
skills.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy, cancels any cancellable skill they are using, and Silences them for 2 turns.

skills.name: Dream Reflection
skills.description: A Skill to be replaced with the countered skill.

skills.name: Biting Wind
skills.description: Any time an enemy unit becomes invulnerable, Zephyrex deals 15 piercing damage to them first.

skills.name: Arcadian Duet
skills.description: Target enemy becomes Invulnerable and Isolated until the end of their next turn.

skills.name: Elegant Sweep
skills.description: On the following turn, Zephyrex deals 25 piercing damage to all enemy Heroes. This skill is Channeled (Being stunned or using a new skill will cancel it).

skills.name: Sonic Thrust
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. This skill Bypasses Invulnerability and can only be used if Wind Step is on cooldown.

skills.name: Wind Step
skills.description: Zephyrex gains 15 damage reduction for 1 turn. This effect is Invisible. If Zephyrex receives a new skill during this time, he gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Perfect Execution
skills.description: Zephyrex deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and gives himself Perfection until the end of his next turn. If Perfection expires, this skill will be disabled for the remainder of the round. Each time this skill is used, it permanently deals 15 more damage.

skills.name: Brush of Wings
skills.description: Elegant Sweep deals 10 less damage, but also heals Zephyrex's team for 10 health.

skills.name: Light of Raphael
skills.description: For 3 turns, Zephyrex gains 20 Shield. During this time, Elegant Sweep hits instantly.

skills.name: Cloud Step
skills.description: Wind Step now lasts an additional turn.

skills.name: Waft
skills.description: Zephyrex becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill can only be used during Wind Step. If Wind Step triggered last turn, deal 10 Piercing damage to all enemies, Bypassing.

skills.name: Fae Prince
skills.description: Every turn that an enemy Hero doesn't deal damage to Zephyrex, that enemy receives 10 additional damage from Zephyrex's next damaging ability.

skills.name: Prod
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, and increases the damage of the next skill they use on Zephyrex by 10 (this effect does not stack).

skills.name: Fell Wind
skills.description: Biting Wind now causes health loss, which does not count as any form of damage.

skills.name: Soulsteal
skills.description: For the next 3 turns, target enemy becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn at the end of each of their turns

skills.name: Winds of Summer
skills.description: Biting Wind and Elegant Sweep now deal Affliction damage.

skills.name: Blazing Flourish
skills.description: Deals 30 Affliction Damage to 1 enemy. The following turn, Elegant Sweep costs 1 less [65].

skills.name: Wingless Wanderer
skills.description: Zephyrex can no longer be stunned during Elegant Sweep. If he receives a new harmful skill while preparing, he will gain Elemental Essence and reset his use of Perfect Execution.

skills.name: Cleave the Veil
skills.description: Zephyrex targets one enemy. At the end of his next turn, if he has not received a new harmful skill, he deals 45 piercing damage to the targeted enemy. Enemy players see this effect as Elegant Sweep. Channeled.

skills.name: Vacuum Blade
skills.description: Any time Biting Wind or Wind Step triggers, Elegant Sweep permanently deals 5 more damage.

skills.name: Vacuum Style: Blade Prison
skills.description: Zephyrex makes target enemy Invulnerable and Isolated for 1 turn. This effect will be reapplied as long as Zephyrex channels it.

skills.name: Sand Spectre
skills.description: Zephyrex cannot be chosen as a target by Blinded skills.

skills.name: Sand in the Eyes
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and blinds them for 3 turns. If the target becomes Invulnerable, this effect is removed.

skills.name: Ominous Rumble
skills.description: Triggering Wind Step marks enemies with Ominous Rumble. Marked enemies are automatically targeted by Arcadian Duet and Jolt, consuming the mark in the process.

skills.name: Jolt
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, Bypassing. If the enemy is affected by Ominous Rumble, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence.

skills.name: Cold and Alone
skills.description: Enemies gain 1 stack of Cold and Alone every turn they are Invulnerable or Isolated. Upon reaching 3 stacks, the target is stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Winter's Bite
skills.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy, and any enemy marked by Cold and Alone.

skills.name: Oceans Gather
skills.description: When Zev'kir reaches 1 stack of Call Tides, he gains Elemental Essence. When he reaches 2 stacks, his harmful skills will stun their primary target for 1 turn. When he reaches 3 stacks, his skills affect all valid targets.

skills.name: Call Tides
skills.description: Zev'kir begins Channelling, gaining a stack of Call Tides each turn. These stacks are consumed on him using a new non-Strategic skill.

skills.name: Riptide
skills.description: Zev'kir deals 5 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 damage per stack of Call Tides Zev'kir has.

skills.name: Bubble Prison
skills.description: Zev'kir deals 15 damage to target enemy for 1 turn, increased by 1 turn per stack of Call Tides Zev'kir has. This skill will end if Zev'kir is stunned.

skills.name: Repulse
skills.description: Zev'kir counters the first harmful skill received by target ally. If a skill is countered, Zek'vir will automatically begin channeling Call Tides. This effect is invisible.

skills.name: Tidal Wave
skills.description: Zev'kir deals 45 piercing damage to target enemy. This skill costs 1 less [2] per stack of Call Tides Zev'kir has.

skills.name: Submerged Leyline
skills.description: Zevkir's allies deal 5 additional damage while he Channels Call Tides.

skills.name: Leyline Bolt
skills.description: Deals 25 Damage to a random enemy. If used during Call Tides, it affects target enemy instead, and deals Piercing damage.

skills.name: Atlantean Hymn
skills.description: Allies heal for 5 health per turn during Call Tides.

skills.name: Purelight Pool
skills.description: Heals target ally for 20 health. This causes 5 additional healing for every stack of Call Tides on Zev'Kir

skills.name: Sanguine Spectre
skills.description: Zev'kir heals for 10 health whenever he deals damage. If he is at full health, he instead gains a stack of Call Tides.

skills.name: Crimson Tide
skills.description: Zev'kir targets all enemies, losing 5 health for each enemy targeted. The following turn, each targeted enemy takes 15 Affliction Damage, plus 5 for each stack of Call Tides on Zev'kir.

skills.name: Static Maelstrom
skills.description: Channeling Call Tides now changes Zev'kir's costs to Generic, and causes him to deal 10 additional damage with his next ability.

skills.name: Crackling Slipstream
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If Zev'kir has at least 3 stacks of Call Tides, he applies Static Maelstrom to his team for 1 turn.

skills.name: Freezing Brine
skills.description: Damaging enemies with Riptide adds a stack of Freezing Brine for each stack of Call Tides on Zev'kir. Upon reaching 5 stacks, the enemy is stunned for 1 turn and the stacks are consumed.

skills.name: Cold Snap
skills.description: Targets all stunned allies and invulnerable enemies. Allies become invulnerable until their next turn, and enemies are stunned for their next turn.

skills.name: Patient Predation
skills.description: Call Tides will now continue until a new harmful skill is used on Zev'kir. The harmful skill is reflected to its user and Call Tides ends.

skills.name: Lens of the Deep
skills.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy, and for their next two turns that enemy will receive double damage from reflected skills.

skills.name: Misty Mire
skills.description: Bubble Prison will now target all enemies, dealing 15 Piercing damage to a random target per turn. This damage Bypasses

skills.name: Spear of Fog
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If used on an enemy affected by Bubble Prison, deals double damage and Bypasses.

skills.name: Chains of Atlantis
skills.description: Whenever Zev'kir or his allies end their turn Channeling an ability, a random enemy gains a stack of Chains of Atlantis. Enemies marked by Chains of Atlantis receive 5 Affliction damage per stack during each turn of Call Tides.

skills.name: Abyssal Grasp
skills.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. If Zev'kir is Channeling Call Tides, this damage becomes Piercing. If the damaged enemy is marked by Chains of Atlantis, they are stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Rapid Mutation
skills.description: Zev'kir takes 5 Affliction Damage at the end of each of his turns. For every 15 Health he is missing, Zev'kir has one additional stack of Call Tides

skills.name: Mutable Form
skills.description: Zev'kir gains 10 Shield for 2 turns for each stack of Call Tides he has.

skills.name: Stinking Marsh
skills.description: When Zev'kir has no stacks of Call Tides, his skills are treated as though he had two, and deal Affliction damage instead. Whenever Zev'kir uses a skill with 0 stacks of Call Tides, he takes 10 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Rising Bog
skills.description: Zev'kir consumes his stacks of Call Tides, changing his costs to Generic costs and granting his team 10 Shield per turn. The duration is equal to the number of Call Tides stacks consumed.
